newsitem.title: MEXICO: Power plant for Cemex to cost $300 mln.
newsitem.headline: Power plant for Cemex to cost $300 mln.

text.p: A new private sector power generating plant in the state of San Luis Potosi to supply power to Cemex will cost $300 million, a company official said Wednesday.
"The investment will go ahead over a period of 36 months from its approval by the Cemex board" in seven to 10 months' time, Cemex technology director Luis Farias told reporters.

The 250 MW plant, to be located in San Luis Potosi state, will supply power to 10 Cemex plants in central Mexico and was among a batch of private sector power projects approved by the government's Energy Regulatory Commission in June.
Farias said the project would be mainly financed by banks, with Cemex taking less than 10 percent of the equity.
